scripts.prepare:site: npm run clean:generated && node scripts/generate-projections.mjs site
scripts.prepare:distribution: npm run clean:generated && npm run rdf:generate && node scripts/generate-projections.mjs distribution && node scripts/generate-retrieval-projections.mjs && node scripts/generate-descriptors.mjs
scripts.compile:dist: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && npm run materialize:static && npm run indexnow:prepare && node scripts/generate-deployment-headers.mjs && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prepare:distribution && npm run compile:dist
scripts.release: npm run validate:release-contract && npm run build && npm run release:attest && npm run package:dist
